title: Music Industry Equity & Justice Organizations
description: A curated directory of organizations combating discrimination, promoting equity, and supporting marginalized groups in the music industry.

organizations.name: Black Music Action Coalition (BMAC)
organizations.description: An advocacy group formed to address systemic racism within the music business, hold major labels accountable, and drive policy change.

organizations.name: Black Lives in Music (BLIM)
organizations.description: Focuses on equality for Black, Asian, and ethnically diverse musicians and professionals through research, mentorship, and industry reform.

organizations.name: POWER UP
organizations.description: Initiative co-founded by the PRS Foundation to support Black music creators and industry professionals while tackling anti-Black racism.

organizations.name: Decolonise Fest
organizations.description: A volunteer-run festival and collective highlighting music made by People of Color in punk and alternative scenes.

organizations.name: Keychange
organizations.description: Global movement working toward 50/50 gender balance in music festival lineups, conferences, and rosters.

organizations.name: Women in Music
organizations.description: One of the oldest and largest non-profits dedicated to educating, empowering, and advancing women in the musical arts.

organizations.name: Femme House
organizations.description: Fosters equitable opportunities for women and gender-expansive individuals in music creation, DJing, and production.

organizations.name: Beats By Girlz
organizations.description: Empowers young women and gender-expansive youth through music technology and production education.

organizations.name: Gender Amplified
organizations.description: A non-profit dedicated to celebrating and supporting women and non-binary music producers.

organizations.name: Music Production for Women (MPW)
organizations.description: Online platform providing training, community, and support for women entering audio engineering and production.

organizations.name: The Ally Coalition (TAC)
organizations.description: Works with artists and the music industry to support LGBTQ+ youth and grass-roots advocacy.

organizations.name: Queer Music Agency
organizations.description: An agency and collective focused specifically on elevating LGBTQ+ artists, representation, and safer venue spaces.

organizations.name: Calling All Crows
organizations.description: Mobilizes music fans and artists to combat sexual harassment and assault at live shows through their Here For The Music campaign.

organizations.name: Girls Against
organizations.description: A volunteer organization standing up against sexual assault and misogyny at live music venues.

organizations.name: NOISE FOR NOW
organizations.description: Connects musicians with local reproductive justice and healthcare organizations to fund and support healthcare access.

organizations.name: Attitude is Everything
organizations.description: Works with audiences, artists, and the live music industry to improve accessibility for Deaf and disabled people.

organizations.name: RAMPD (Recording Artists and Music Professionals with Disabilities)
organizations.description: Founded by disabled music creators to build inclusion, advocacy, and accessibility standards across the industry.
